BUNNYNET_API_KEY.description: The account-wide key, reaching pull zones, storage, DNS, stream libraries and billing. This is the one name Bunny documents, in its own Terraform provider, where it is marked sensitive.

BUNNY_STREAM_API_KEY.description: Per video library, and separate from the account key. The name is convention.

BUNNY_STORAGE_ZONE_PASSWORD.description: Per storage zone. Bunny says to use this rather than the account key for storage. The name is convention.

BUNNY_TOKEN_AUTH_KEY.description: Signs URLs. Bunny says to keep it secret because anyone holding it can generate valid tokens, which makes a leak forge access rather than merely grant it. The name is convention.
